description: This file defines the feature for creating a new user, including input validation, handling the create command, checking for existing users, and generating a new user account with JWT token generation.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Encapsulates the user creation feature, including nested classes for command data, validation, and handling logic.

classes.name: Create.UserData
classes.description: Record holding optional username, email, and password for user creation.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request message object carrying user data for the create operation.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the user creation command ensuring required fields are non-empty.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles processing the create user command, including validation, avoiding duplicates, hashing passwords, and generating tokens.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of creating a new user, including database checks, password hashing, and token generation.
